title: Apartment Home Lease Late Charge Tariff
content:
The late charge values of the Apartment Home Lease are fixed per floor plan. They are the product figures that the lease's late fee rules read; the state-specific timing and caps are not part of this tariff.

| Floor plan | Grace period (calendar days after the due date) | Initial late fee — flat component | Initial late fee — percentage of monthly rent | Daily late fee | Maximum daily late fees per billing period | Company cap on all late fees of a billing period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 3 | $75.00 | 5% | $10.00 | 10 | 12% of monthly rent |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 3 | $85.00 | 5% | $10.00 | 10 | 12% of monthly rent |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 3 | $95.00 | 5% | $12.00 | 10 | 12% of monthly rent |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 3 | $100.00 | 5% | $12.00 | 10 | 12% of monthly rent |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 3 | $125.00 | 5% | $15.00 | 10 | 12% of monthly rent |
| Penthouse Residence | 3 | $150.00 | 5% | $20.00 | 10 | 12% of monthly rent |

### Tariff notes

1. **Grace period** — the calendar days after the rent due date during which rent may be paid without a late fee: 3 on every floor plan.
2. **Initial late fee, flat and percentage components** — the tariff gives the initial late fee two components: a flat dollar amount and a percentage (0.05, that is 5 percent) applied to the monthly rent; the initial fee is the greater of the two.
3. **Daily late fee** — the additional late fee for each calendar day after the initial late fee day that rent remains unpaid, in dollars per day.
4. **Maximum daily late fees** — the most daily late fees that may be charged for one billing period: 10 on every floor plan.
5. **Company cap** — the company's cap on all late fees of one billing period, expressed as a fraction of the monthly rent: 0.12, that is 12 percent, on every floor plan.

### Hypothetical comparison

With an example monthly rent of $1,800.00, 5 percent of rent is $90.00. On the Studio Residence the flat component of $75.00 is lower, so the greater of the two is $90.00; on the Two-Bedroom Residence the flat component of $100.00 is higher, so the greater of the two is $100.00. The company cap at 12 percent of that rent is $216.00 on either floor plan. The rent is an example input only.
